translations.web: She said to him, “Not so, because this great wrong in sending me away is worse than the other that you did to me!” But he would not listen to her.
translations.bsb: “No,” she replied, “sending me away is worse than this great wrong you have already done to me!” But he refused to listen to her.
translations.kjv: And she said unto him, There is no cause: this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that thou didst unto me. But he would not hearken unto her.
translations.asv: And she said unto him, Not so, because this great wrong in putting me forth is worse than the other that thou didst unto me. But he would not hearken unto her.
